title: Production Technician
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

- You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

- You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

- Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

- Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Maintain, troubleshoot and repair machinery across our magnet factory,keeping equipment safe, accurate and available.

- Carry out preventive maintenance, inspections and repairs on mechanical, electromechanical and pneumatic systems.

- Diagnose breakdowns, intermittent faults and undocumented failures. Resolve the root cause and verify safe operation before returning equipment to service.

- Assemble, install, align, and commission new equipment.

- Support factory and site acceptance tests, installation checks.

- Work with multiple teams to distinguish machine faults from setup, material, process or measurement problems.

- Work with controls and manufacturing engineering to tune equipment, including winding tension, motion, vacuum and thermal profiles, within approved process limits.

- Identify wear early, flag long-lead items and communicate to the lead technician.

- Record failure modes, downtime, repairs, parts used and equipment modifications.

- Apply lockout/tagout, safe isolation, stored-energy controls and controlled restart procedures.

- Provide clear handovers on equipment condition, outstanding faults and any operating restrictions.

WHO YOU ARE

- A technical apprenticeship or vocational qualification in industrial maintenance, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or mechatronics, or equivalent hands-on experience.

- Hands-on experience maintaining and repairing production or process equipment.

- Strong electrical and mechanical diagnostic skills.

- The ability to interpret engineering drawings, equipment manuals and electrical or pneumatic schematics, and practical familiarity with mechanisms, pneumatics, drives and sensors.

Kaluza https://www.kaluza.com/ is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?
Kaluza runs the billing and payments engine behind some of the world's biggest energy retailers. Every bill sent and every payment collected across Kaluza's markets increasingly runs through one shared core platform, and GBPA exists to build and run that core, so foundational billing and payments capability gets built once and reused everywhere, rather than rebuilt separately for every new market or client relationship.

That matters because of where Kaluza is headed: as we grow into new markets and take on more of the world's largest energy retailers as clients, rebuilding core billing and payments capability separately for each one is slower, costlier, and more error-prone than building it once and configuring it at the edge. Getting this right directly shapes how fast Kaluza can bring new markets and clients onto the platform, and how reliable that platform is once they're on it.

We're also in the middle of reorganising how this part of the business works, moving from building billing and payments capability separately per area toward one shared global core that every area configures rather than rebuilds. - You'll diagnose systemic and organisational issues using deep domain knowledge, not just resolve team-level technical problems.

- You'll manage cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Delivery, and adjacent engineering teams to align roadmap and trade-offs.

- You'll carry full people-leader ownership for both teams: goal-setting, performance and pay conversations, hiring and recruitment.

- You'll operate in a high-integrity data domain (billing and payments) where reliability and reconciliation come before speed.

- Have experience owning technical and product strategy across multiple domains or services simultaneously.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert und organisiert.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior- über Senior- und bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

description: Paradromics | Embedded Software Engineer | Austin, TX or Oakland, CA | Onsite | Full-time Paradromics is building a high bandwidth brain-machine interface for clinical use. The implant we built is restoring function to patients by streaming out neural data from specific brain regions in real time, which we convert to e.g. speech using machine learning. Check out our recent article in the NYT: https://archive.ph/C6CRb . We're looking for help in further developing and hardening our embedded Linux components, which work in tandem with FPGAs and our custom ASICs to read out neural data. Some of the ongoing efforts are: HIL testing on real devices, integrating new sensor ASICs, maintaining our Yocto build system, exploratory work on prototypes, improving our clinical UX, and improving the core code that receives and massages data. The code is largely written in Rust with a little Typescript, (and bash, and bitbake recipes, etc). You'll be expected to have experience constructing reliable and understandable software in Linux, and some level of experience in building and interacting with embedded hardware. Rust experience is ideal but not necessary. We're not looking for a specific number of YoE, but for motivated and hungry engineers who want to push the frontier of brain-machine interfaces. • Experience building or operating within SOC 2-compliant systems with enterprise-grade security and privacy - you've handled sensitive customer data under real compliance constraints (access controls, encryption, data isolation, auditability) and treat it as a first-class engineering requirement.

description:

Circle ’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .
What you’ll be part of:
Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
What you’ll be responsible for:
Circle is looking for a Regulatory and Licensing Program Manager to drive our licensing applications from filing strategy through to approval. Every new license, registration, or charter is a multi-month program on a regulatory clock, and it pulls in work from teams across the company. You will have early visibility into sensitive business and regulatory decisions. Handling that information with discretion is a core part of the role.

This is a program management role that requires real regulatory depth. You will run several applications at once and set the standard every future one follows. Regional policy and legal leaders own the strategy and the regulator relationship; you make the program move. In practice that means deciding what happens in what order, putting a name against every task, and getting the executive steering committee what it needs before it meets. We use AI heavily on this team and expect you to do the same. It is how a portfolio this wide stays manageable.

You will see every market Circle is considering before the decision is made, and you will be in the room with the people making it. How this function works is largely yours to define, and you will do it as an individual contributor leading by influence.

• Supporting Circle 's licensing applications end-to-end, from the case for entering a market through to approval, running several programs at once.

• Building the program plan for each market - sequencing, dependencies, owners, dates - and holding it as the plan everyone works from.

• Partnering with cross-functional teams, including Legal, Commercial, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, Product, Engineering, People & Workplace, and others to turn regulatory requirements into executable plans.

• Facilitating working sessions and executive steering committee briefings that drive programs forward, from setting the agenda and framing decisions to closing the loop on outcomes.

• Tracking and managing risks across all active programs, owning the escalation path and getting the right people involved early.

• Defining and managing the reporting and metrics that give senior leadership and cross-functional partners an accurate, up-to-date picture of every market in the portfolio.

• Establishing and evolving scalable service standards for how Circle runs regulatory and licensing programs.

• Supporting, as directed, in external procurement activities across scoping, contracting, budget, and delivery.

• Strengthening how the global policy organization works: bringing the same discipline to consultations, submissions, briefings and events, and to whatever else the team needs run well.

As a Senior Quality Engineer embedded in the Reporting/BI Engineering team, you will be the primary quality voice for a scrum team focused on building and enhancing the financial reporting and business intelligence capabilities of theCertentEquity Management (CEM) platform for a large, strategic enterprise client engagement. You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

We are looking for an Email Infrastructure & Deliverability Specialist to build, launch, and manage a high-volume email-sending infrastructure from the ground up. This role will own the technical setup and ongoing operation of the email-sending environment, including the selection and configuration of appropriate sending platforms and infrastructure. The specialist will manage campaigns across new and legacy contact lists, with a focus on inbox placement, sender reputation, and reliable delivery at scale. The goal is to establish a sustainable email operation capable of supporting approximately 300,000-500,000 emails per day while maintaining strong deliverability and responsible list management.

• Remote-first flexibility. Work from anywhere.

• PTO and paid U.S. holidays

• Build and implement the email-sending infrastructure from scratch, selecting and configuring the platforms and technical components required for high-volume email delivery.

• Configure and maintain email authentication and sending infrastructure to support reliable delivery and protect sender reputation.

• Develop and manage a scalable sending operation capable of supporting approximately 300,000-500,000 emails per day.

• Experience managing new and legacy contact lists, including list quality, segmentation, consent considerations, bounces, and unsubscribe management.

title: Director, Clinical Operations
description:
About Lifeforce

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.

Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.

Overview

Lifeforce is hiring a Director, Clinical Operations to run the operating engine behind our national proactive care delivery model. You'll own how clinicians get licensed, credentialed, onboarded, scheduled, supported, and reviewed for quality, and you'll make sure all of it holds up as we grow.

And we're growing fast. Our network of 50+ physicians, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants is expected to more than triple over the next 15 months, across a growing number of states. At the same time, we're opening physical longevity centers and the clinicians supporting those centers run through this role too. The systems that work for a network of 50 won't work at 200, and this role is the one that gets us there ahead of demand rather than behind it.

This is primarily an operations leadership role, not a clinical one. Clinical standards and clinical judgment stay with the Medical Director and clinical leadership. You'll own the people, processes, systems, and data that let clinicians do their best work at scale. You'll report to the COO and lead four teams: Clinical Operations, Clinical Onboarding & Enablement, Credentialing & Licensing, and Clinical Quality Assurance. You'll start with a small team and build it out to about 15 people by the end of 2027.

Key Responsibilities

Capacity & Scheduling

• Own clinician capacity planning against member demand, state by state. Know where we'll be short a quarter before it happens.

• Own clinician scheduling, including how appointments are assigned across telehealth, nurse services, and our centers, and how continuity of care is protected as the network grows. Work with Product and Engineering to build the tools for scheduling that the teams need.

• Track utilization, panel concentration, and access (time to next appointment), and act when they drift.

Hire to Productive

• Own the full clinician pipeline after the offer: licensure, credentialing, onboarding, training, and ramp to full schedule.

• Set and hit targets for time to credentialed and time- to-productive, and fix the bottlenecks in between.

• Build a licensure and DEA strategy that ensures compliance and keeps pace with growth.

Quality & Clinician Performance

• Previous experience in a health tech, SaaS, or AI-focused organization.

Why Join Us

• Collaborate in a high-ownership environment with modern tools and cloud-native practices.

title: Growth Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Wir verwalten über 70.000 Einheiten in ganz Deutschland. Das ist nicht das Geschäft, das ist die Plattform. Darauf bauen wir neue Verticals auf: Versicherung, Energie, Finanzierung und Brokerage. Für Brokerage suchen wir jetzt die Person, die daraus ein echtes Geschäft macht.

Darum geht es

Viele unserer Eigentümer wollen irgendwann verkaufen oder neu vermieten. Wir sitzen direkt an der Quelle und kennen Objekte, Eigentümer und Timing. Deine Aufgabe ist, daraus eine planbare Akquise-Maschine zu bauen: Du identifizierst die richtigen Eigentümer aus unserem Bestand, sprichst sie gezielt an und wandelst erstes Interesse in hochqualifizierte Leads für unsere Makler um.

Das ist keine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien und Roadmaps. Du baust selbst: Kampagnen, Outbound-Workflows, Automatisierungen, Funnels. Du weißt jede Woche, welche Zahl du bewegt hast. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership-Team, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen.

Was du machst

- Akquise-Engine aufbauen: Du analysierst unseren Bestand, findest Eigentümer mit Verkaufs- oder Vermietungsbedarf und baust Workflows für Datenanreicherung, Lead-Scoring und automatisierte Ansprache.

- Marketing selbst umsetzen: Du baust und optimierst die Kanäle, die Leads bringen, von Outbound über Performance-Kampagnen bis zu In-App-Triggern im richtigen Moment.

- Funnel und Zahlen verantworten: Du definierst KPIs vom Lead bis zum Mandat, trackst Kosten pro Lead und Conversion und optimierst so lange, bis die Unit Economics stimmen.

- Schnell testen: Daten-Trigger, Kanäle, Messaging und Lead-Magneten. Du hast eine klare Meinung, was du ausprobieren willst, und misst es sauber.

Was du mitbringst

- 3+ Jahre operative Erfahrung in Growth oder Performance Marketing, mit eigener Verantwortung für Leads, Conversion oder Umsatz.

- Du hast Dinge von null aufgebaut, etwa als Gründer:in, als Geschäftsführer:in eines kleinen Unternehmens oder in einer frühen Startup-Phase. Das ist für uns ein starkes Signal.

- Hands-on-Erfahrung mit datengetriebener Akquise: Outbound, Datenanreicherung, CRM und Automatisierung.

- Marketing-Erfahrung mit Performance-Kanälen und Kampagnen ist ein klares Plus.

- Erfahrung in Immobilien, PropTech oder Marktplätzen ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

- Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mindestens C1). Du sprichst täglich mit Eigentümern und unseren Hausverwaltungen.

- Du lebst in Berlin oder ziehst her und reist gern zu unseren Standorten in ganz Deutschland.

Bitte nicht bewerben, wenn

- du vor allem Strategie machen und die Umsetzung anderen überlassen willst,

- du erst ein Team führen möchtest, bevor das Modell bewiesen ist,

- du nicht bereit bist, in Berlin zu arbeiten.

Was wir bieten

- Ein Vertical, das du von Anfang an prägst, mit 70.000 Einheiten als Basis und voller Rückendeckung vom Leadership-Team.

- Ein Inside-Sales-Team, auf das du zugreifen kannst: Es übernimmt Anrufe und die Bearbeitung deiner Kampagnen, damit du dich auf den Aufbau der Akquise-Engine konzentrieren kannst.

- Einen direkten Weg zur Verantwortung: Wenn Brokerage funktioniert, skalierst du es weiter.

- Top-Vergütung inklusive virtueller Aktienoptionen und 500 € Wohnzuschuss pro Monat in der Nähe unseres Büros.

- 110 € Lunch-Budget und 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss pro Monat, täglich Frühstück und Spezialitäten-Kaffee im Office.

- 1.200 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr.

title: Software Engineer II, Cloud Applications

We're looking for an engineer who is excited to learn these systems and contribute to their scalability, reliability, and developer experience. - Improve service operability through tests, instrumentation, dashboards, alerts, runbooks, and documentation.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Cloud Network)
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

Every transaction at Nubank travels across a network before it reaches a customer. As we grow across countries, accounts, regions and hybrid environments, the connectivity layer underneath has to stay fast, segmented, auditable and cheap to run - while never becoming the thing that takes the platform down.

As a Lead Software Engineer on a Cloud Network platform engineering team, you set and evolve the technical direction for how Nubank connects its cloud, hybrid and on-premises environments. You own problems whose scope spreads across several teams and business units, and you are expected to bring structure to ambiguity rather than wait for it to be resolved for you.

This is an IC6 role: you lead through technical depth, design authority and influence rather than direct reports. The goal you own is a cloud network platform that scales with the business, holds up under audit, and gets simpler over time instead of more complex.

YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Setting and evolving the technical direction of the cloud network platform owned by your team, aligning with Nubank's canonical approaches and contributing back to the broader technical community.

- Leading high-level and low-level design for connectivity patterns across multi-account, multi-region, multi-geo and hybrid-cloud topologies, independently making sound architectural decisions in multi-component, multi-team designs.

- Managing complex network projects and processes end to end - working independently, coordinating across subjects and stakeholders, and escalating for managerial support in a timely way rather than reactively.

- Proactively reducing long-term complexity through simplification, consolidation, deprecation and paved roads, explicitly balancing scalability, maintainability and cost, and considering both human and AI interaction with the platform.

- Owning the operational health of the network platform in your team's scope: leading complex incident response (diagnosis, coordination, resolution), driving complex postmortems, and owning the short- and long-term tech debt strategy that comes out of them.

- Promoting a culture of safe change - feature flags, gradual rollout, monitoring, fast rollback - applied to network changes, and driving simplification and cost optimization across the topology.

- Setting and enforcing quality standards for the team's automation and infrastructure code: testing practices, code review bar, reusable modules, and anticipation of quality and maintainability needs coming from business strategy.

- Defining observability for the platform - robust monitoring, controls and SLAs that surface issues proactively rather than after customer impact.

- Bringing a strong end-to-end domain understanding: tracing a business process from product through the transactional path down to the network and data layers, and understanding how network design choices propagate through it.

- Owning the network security posture of your scope, including PCI DSS or equivalent standards, segmentation, and controls that hold up under audit.

- Evaluating buy vs. build options and new products and technologies, being data-driven about stability, reliability, scalability and cost before committing to a solution.

- Mentoring IC4/IC5 engineers on the broader system landscape, design reasoning and operational practice, and raising the bar of the people around you.

title: Member of Technical Staff, Modeling
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Member of Technical Staff, Modeling in Harvey Research, you’ll own how we adapt and improve leading open-weight models for legal work.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own the post-training recipe across SFT and RL, including reward design and verification for challenging, semi-verifiable legal tasks. You’ll help set the research direction and carry ideas from experiments through training runs to models used by customers. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work.

We’re looking for research engineers and scientists who have gotten training runs working at scale, are immersed in RL for language models, and want their work to reach users quickly.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research http://harvey.ai/research.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own and pursue a research agenda to improve model capability on long-horizon legal reasoning and agentic workflows.

- Design and run post-training experiments across SFT and RL, building on leading open-weight models.

- Develop reward functions and verifiers for semi-verifiable tasks, including rubrics, learned preference models, and expert preference data, and study where they break.

- Run and debug training at scale, addressing divergence, reward hacking, and instability.

- Build and use rigorous evals to track improvements and decide what ships.

- Design, implement, test, and debug code across our research stack.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- Hands-on experience post-training LLMs with SFT and RL, including preference optimization, and direct ownership of training runs and results.

- Deep ML fundamentals and experience getting distributed training runs working reliably.

- Strong engineering skills in Python, with production-quality code and end-to-end system ownership.

- Research experience in RL for language models or reward modeling, with the ability to move quickly from experiments to shipped improvements. Publications welcome, not required.

We are hiring for this role across multiple levels.

COMPENSATION

$230,000 - $340,000 USD
